facts.fact: The Civil Registry Department and ZEC began handing voter registration and voters' roll management to the Registrar-General, including Biometric Voter Registration (BVR) kits and network infrastructure, with continuous voter registration continuing.

A deputy chief secretary in the Office of the President and Cabinet says voter registration is being integrated into the national civil registration framework so that citizen data captured at the Registrar-General's office carries into the voters' roll.
